package postgres

import (
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestAuthoringJobMigrationContainsRepositoryColumns(t *testing.T) {
	payload, err := os.ReadFile("../../../../db/migrations/001_authoring_jobs.up.sql")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	migration := string(payload)
	for _, required := range []string{
		"artifact_json jsonb",
		"lease_token uuid",
		"lease_expires_at timestamptz",
	} {
		if !strings.Contains(migration, required) {
			t.Fatalf("authoring job migration is missing %q", required)
		}
	}
	if strings.Contains(migration, "publication_json") {
		t.Fatal("publication_json must be owned by migration 002 so rollback order remains valid")
	}
}

func TestPublicationReceiptMigrationOwnsColumn(t *testing.T) {
	payload, err := os.ReadFile("../../../../db/migrations/002_publication_receipt.up.sql")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	migration := strings.ToLower(string(payload))
	if !strings.Contains(migration, "add column if not exists publication_json") {
		t.Fatalf("publication migration must add publication_json safely: %s", migration)
	}
}

func TestPrivateStagingMigrationAddsForwardStateWithoutRewritingHistory(t *testing.T) {
	payload, err := os.ReadFile("../../../../db/migrations/003_private_staging_receipt.up.sql")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	migration := strings.ToLower(string(payload))
	for _, required := range []string{"staging_json", "'staged'", "artifact_json is not null"} {
		if !strings.Contains(migration, required) {
			t.Fatalf("staging migration is missing %q: %s", required, migration)
		}
	}
	if strings.Contains(migration, "update tz_authoring_job") || strings.Contains(migration, "drop column") {
		t.Fatalf("staging migration must preserve historical rows and columns: %s", migration)
	}
}

func TestTechnicalTaskUsesExistingVersionedArtifactWithoutDuplicateColumn(t *testing.T) {
	payload, err := os.ReadFile("../../../../db/migrations/001_authoring_jobs.up.sql")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	migration := strings.ToLower(string(payload))
	if !strings.Contains(migration, "artifact_json jsonb") {
		t.Fatal("technical task source candidate requires the existing artifact_json boundary")
	}
	if strings.Contains(migration, "technical_task_json") {
		t.Fatal("technical task must not duplicate blueprint semantics in a second column")
	}
}
